# Plasmaman
[color=#ffa500]Warning! This species is not recommended for new players due to their combustion in oxygen![/color]
Plasmamen breathe plasma instead of oxygen, a rare substance that is difficult to find compressed into tanks. Plasma is highly flammable when introduced to oxygen and body heat, requiring plasmamen to wear a containment suit at all times. These suits provide a built-in headlamp and welding protection.
Plasmamen always spawn wearing a plasma envirosuit, helmet, and working plasma internals. A spare breathing mask and an emergency plasma canister is provided in their survival box.
Plasmamen do not have blood, being composed of a skeletal structure and internal organs.
Plasmamen do not require food or water, and have no sense of taste.
Plasmamen can be [color=#1e90ff]slowly healed by plasma dust.[/color]
Plasmamen are [color=#1e90ff]immune to Radiation damage[/color], but take [color=#ffa500]50% more Burn damage.[/color]
